description: The standard 15-node shape brought up and producing: 7 bp, 7 en and 1 pn. Endpoints reach the producers through the pn rather than dialling one, so this is also the smallest check that a proxied network of the standard size comes up at all. One file runs all three chains; swap the chain with --chain-preset and --binary. The wbft and wemix copies this replaced differed only in the preset, and the wemix one dropped the validator count because go-wemix has no validator RPC — the count is now read from its governance contract. The wait is wemix's (300s), the slowest to come up; waitBlock returns as soon as the height is reached.
